questions.stem: Louis Vuitton is one of the most famous brands in today’s fashion world and has long stood for fanciness and wealth. However, the high-end brand came from humble beginnings. It all started in 19th-century Paris when Louis Vuitton arrived in the city at the age of 16 to make a living. No one ever thought the ordinary poor boy would go on to become the founder of a famous luggage and handbag kingdom. Based on the passage, which of the following best describes Louis Vuitton?

options.A: He went from rags to riches.
options.B: He worked his way through college.
options.C: He made a name for himself at the age of 16.
options.D: He expanded his business to the United States.

questions.explain:
解析: …但是這高檔名牌剛開始時不起眼…沒有人會想到這普通窮小男孩後來
會變成出名行李箱與袋子王國的創辦人。 from rags to riches 從赤貧到巨富
依照句意 選a

questions.stem: The Nobel Prizes were created by Swedish scientist and businessman Alfred Nobel, who got rich by selling dynamite. He used his fortune to fund the awards after his death. He wanted the money to go to people from all over the world who made great achievements in physics, chemistry, medicine, literature, and peace. Later, a sixth category was added for economics. Which of the following is NOT a category of the Nobel Prize?
questions.explain:
解析:諾貝爾獎是由瑞典科學家與商人Alfred Nobel創立， Alfred Nobel藉由賣
炸藥致富 ...他想要把錢給在物理、化學、醫學、文學 與 和平 這些類別有高
成就貢獻的人。之後，新增的第六項為經濟類別 依照句意 哪項沒有屬於諾貝
爾類別? 選d 音樂
